The mirror ratio is the likely problem. M2 has an effective width of 39.57 µm × 3 = 118.7 µm, and the reference M3 is only 0.793 µm wide, so the ratio is about 150:1. That makes the output-stage current roughly 1.6 mA (about 3 mW at 1.8 V), which matches the power violation. The other specs have margin, so the fault is likely a reference that is too narrow or a multiplier that is too large, not a problem with the gain stage. I can't tell from the numbers alone whether M3 was narrowed or M2's multiplier was raised, so I rank M3 first and M2 second.
